llm.summary: This instruction-only skill is coherent for organizing an Obsidian vault, but it can cause broad note searches, automatic note rewrites, new relationship-note creation, and deletion without clear approval safeguards.

dimensions.detail: The requested file reading, searching, and note editing are aligned with an Obsidian knowledge-graph organization skill, and there is no code, install step, network endpoint, or credential requirement in the provided artifacts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions require the agent to continue searching and creating relationship notes during read/write/split operations and sometimes delete notes, rather than limiting changes to an explicit user-approved edit.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec, binaries, environment variables, credentials, or code files are present; the scanner also reported no static findings.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill points at an Obsidian vault workflow and includes broad search/load behavior, but does not clearly define allowed vault paths, exclusions, backups, or approval boundaries for write/delete operations.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs the agent to add or rewrite persistent frontmatter such as agent_trigger, which can affect what future agents load and treat as task-relevant context.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting the agent reorganize your Obsidian vault. Before using it, make a backup, set an explicit vault path, and instruct the agent to ask before any write, rename, merge, agent_trigger update, or deletion.

evidence.explanation: A simple read operation can trigger new note creation, and some cleanup paths can delete notes, with no explicit requirement for user confirmation, preview, backup, or rollback.
evidence.snippet: 读取已有笔记（read_file）→ 发现内容中提到其他主体 → 检查是否已有关系笔记 → 无则建 ... 如果无法判断缺失端的内容和类型 → 删除该关系笔记

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use this only on a backed-up vault and require the agent to show a diff and ask for approval before creating, moving, merging, or deleting any notes.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Asking the agent to inspect or edit one note could cause additional files in the vault to be created, rewritten, merged, or deleted.

evidence.explanation: One note operation is designed to cascade into searches and additional relationship-note creation across the vault, without a clear containment limit.
evidence.snippet: 新建/拆分/读到主体笔记 → 同一轮次内搜关联 → 至少建一条关系笔记 ... 对任何主体笔记进行读、写、拆分操作时，立即触发关联检查并建关系笔记。不可等、不可拖。

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Limit runs to a selected folder or note set, cap the number of automatic changes, and require batch review before applying changes.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A small requested change could expand into many vault-wide edits, making mistakes harder to notice or undo.

evidence.explanation: The skill can persist agent_trigger metadata and rewrite notes into agent-executable guidance, which may influence future agent context loading and behavior.
evidence.snippet: Skill笔记 | agent_trigger: frontmatter | 搜到即加载 ... 用得上 → 提炼 agent_trigger + 必要时改写内容为 agent 可执行格式

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Only add agent_trigger fields after user review, keep agent-loadable notes in a trusted location, and avoid treating arbitrary vault notes as authoritative instructions.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Private or untrusted note content could become persistent agent context and affect later tasks beyond the original note-editing session.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill’s rules can force additional searches, writes, relationship-note creation, and deletion beyond the immediately requested note action.

permission_boundary.summary: The provided artifacts do not request credentials, account access, elevated privileges, or third-party service authority.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: Persistent agent_trigger and L0/L1/L2 loading rules can cause vault note content to be reused as future agent context without clearly defined trust boundaries.
